claim.claim-text: 1. An isolated monoclonal antibody, comprising a CD152-binding domain, wherein the CD152-binding domain comprises an immunoglobulin heavy chain variable region comprising CDR1, CDR2, and CDR3, wherein the CDR1, CDR2, and CDR3 comprise amino acid sequences as set forth in

2. The isolated monoclonal antibody of claim 1, wherein the antibody is a heavy-chain-only antibody, preferably wherein the antibody comprises two immunoglobulin heavy chains or consists of two immunoglobulin heary chains.

3. The isolated monoclonal antibody of claim 1 or 2, wherein the immunoglobulin heavy chain variable region comprises an amino acid sequence having at least 80%, 85%, 88%, 90%, 92%, 95%, 97%, 98%, 99%, or 100% identity to SEQ ID NOs: 183, 9, 105, 3, 15, 21, 27, 33, 39, 45, 51, 57, 63, 69, 75, 81, 87, 93, 99, 111, 117, 123, 129, 135, 141, 147, 153, 159, 165, 171, 177, or 189.

4. The isolated monoclonal antibody of claim 2 or 3, wherein at least one of the two immunoglobulin heavy chains comprises an amino acid sequence having at least 80%, 85%, 88%, 90%, 92%, 95%, 97%, 98%, 99%, or 100% identity to SEQ ID NOs: 182, 8, 104, 110, 140, 146, 152, 170, 2, 14, 20, 26, 32, 38, 44, 50, 56, 62, 68, 74, 80, 86, 92, 98, 116, 122, 128, 134, 158, 164, 176, or 188.

5. The isolated monoclonal antibody of any one of claims 1 to 4, which exhibits one or a combination of the following properties: (a) binding to human CD152; (b) binding specifically to monkey CD152; (c) not binding to mouse CD152; (d) blocking the binding of CD 152 to CD80, CD86, or both; (e) promoting secretion of IL-2 by immune cells; (f) inducing T-cell activation; (g) stimulating an anti-tumor immune response by immune cells; and/or which exhibits one or a combination of the following properties: (a) binding to human CD152 with an affinity higher than that of an ipilimumab analogue; (b) binding to human CD152 with the affinity that is at least 2-fold, at least 5-fold, at least 10-fold, at least 20-fold, at least 30-fold, at least 50-fold, or at least 100-fold higher than that of an ipilimumab analogue; (c) dissociating from human CD 152 with a K<d> of 1.0*10<-9> M or less; (d) dissociating from human CD152 with the K<d> that is lower than that of an ipilimumab analogue; (e) dissociating from human CD152 with the K<d> that is at least 2-fold, at least 5-fold, at least 10-fold, at least 20-fold, at least 30-fold, at least 50-fold, or at least 100-fold lower than that of an ipilimumab analogue, wherein the ipilimumab analogue is a monoclonal antibody which specifically binds to CTLA-4 and comprises a heavy chain with an amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO.: 199 and a light chain with an amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO.: 200.;6. The isolated monoclonal antibody of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the antibody dissociates from human CD152 with a K<d> of 6.0*10<-11> M or less.
7. The isolated monoclonal antibody of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the antibody is a human, humanized, or chimeric antibody.

8. A pharmaceutical composition, comprising the isolated monoclonal antibody of any of claim 1 to 7, and a pharmaceutically acceptable excipient, preferably wherein the pharmaceutically acceptable excipient is selected from the group consisting of carriers, surface active agents, thickening or emulsifying agents, solid binders, dispersion or suspension aids, solubilizers, colorants, flavoring agents, coatings, disintegrating agents, lubricants, sweeteners, preservatives, isotonic agents, and a combination thereof.

9. The pharmaceutical composition of claim 8, further comprising a second antibody, wherein the second antibody is an immunostimulatory antibody or costimulatory antibody, preferably wherein the immunostimulatory antibody is selected from the group consisting of an anti-PD-1 antibody, an anti-PD-L1 antibody, an anti-LAG-3 antibody, an anti-TIM 3 antibody, an anti-STAT3 antibody, and an anti-ROR1 antibody; and/or preferably wherein the costimulatory antibody is an anti-CD137 antibody or an anti-GITR antibody.

10. A nucleic acid molecule encoding the isolated antibody of any one of claims 1 to 7, preferably wherein the nucleic acid molecule comprises a nucleotide sequence having at least 80%, 85%, 88%, 90%, 92%, 95%, 97%, 98%, 99%, or 100% identity to SEQ ID NO: 181, 7, 103, 109, 139, 145, 151, 169, 1, 13, 19, 25, 31, 37, 43, 49, 55, 61, 67, 73, 79, 85, 91, 97, 115, 121, 127, 133, 163, 175, or 187.

11. An expression vector comprising the nucleic acid molecule of claim 10, wherein the nucleic acid molecule is operatively linked to regulatory sequences suitable for expression of the nucleic acid segment in a host cell.
12. A host cell comprising the expression vector of claim 11.

13. The isolated monoclonal antibody of any one of claims 1 to 7 or the pharmaceutical composition of claim 8 or 9, for use in the treatment of a disorder, wherein the disorder is a cancer or an autoimmune disease, preferably wherein the disorder is a cancer, preferably wherein the cancer is selected from the group consisting of leukemia, lymphoma, CLL, small lymphocytic lymphoma, marginal cell B-Cell lymphoma, Burkett's Lymphoma, renal cell carcinoma, colon cancer, colorectal cancer, breast cancer, epithelial squamous cell cancer, melanoma, myeloma, stomach cancer, brain cancer, lung cancer, pancreatic cancer, cervical cancer, ovarian cancer, liver cancer, bladder cancer, prostate cancer, testicular cancer, thyroid cancer, and head and neck cancer.

14. The isolated monoclonal antibody or the pharmaceutical composition for use according to claim 13, wherein the isolated monoclonal antibody or the pharmaceutical composition is combined with an additional therapeutic agent, preferably wherein the additional therapeutic agent is an anti-cancer agent, or wherein the additional therapeutic agent is Ipilimumab or a biosimilar product thereof, wherein the biosimilar product is a monoclonal antibody which specifically binds to CTLA-4 and comprises a heavy chain with an amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO.: 199 and a light chain with an amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO.: 200.
